message.reasoning_content:
The user wants me to convert an image of a webpage (MDN Web Docs - Mozilla 欢迎页面) into HTML. Let me analyze the layout carefully.

The page has:
1. A top banner (MongoDB Atlas ad)
2. MDN navigation bar with logo, menu items, search
3. Breadcrumb navigation
4. Three-column layout:
   - Left sidebar: navigation menu with filters and topics
   - Main content: the article content
   - Right sidebar: table of contents and an ad

Let me build this step by step.

Key elements:
- Top banner: MongoDB Atlas ad with "Get started for free" button
- MDN header with navigation
- Breadcrumb: 学习 Web 开发 > 核心学习模块 > 使用 HTML 构建 Web > Mozilla 欢迎页面
- Theme and language selectors on the right
- Left sidebar with filter and navigation items
- Main content with title, navigation links, info boxes, tables, headings, paragraphs, lists
- Right sidebar with "本文内容" (table of contents) and an ad

Let me create the HTML with proper styling to match the layout.
